topic_title: Reducing Risk — Licensing, Registration & Insurance Synthesis
prompt: Why is carrying liability insurance above the state 30/60/25 minimums widely recommended for Texas drivers?

options.text: Because Texas DPS automatically revokes licenses with standard 30/60/25 insurance
Because modern hospital and vehicle repair costs frequently exceed basic minimum limits
Because higher insurance limits grant permission to travel in designated carpool lanes
Because state law exempts higher-coverage drivers from annual safety inspections
